title: A Veil for the Wolf
author: J. M. Crane
blurb: Oscar Reyes, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
